title.zh: 将马林杜克省莫格波格市镇希南加永小村改设为希南加永村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Hinangayon, Mogpog, Marinduque, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Hinangayon
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Hinangayon, Mogpog, Marinduque, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Hinangayon
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Hinangayon, Mogpog và Marinduque thành Barrio với tên gọi Barrio Hinangayon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Hinangayon, Mogpog และ Marinduque เป็น บาริโอในชื่อบาริโอ Hinangayon
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Hinangayon, Mogpog dan Marinduque menjadi Barrio dengan nama Barrio Hinangayon
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Hinangayon, Mogpog dan Marinduque kepada Barrio dengan nama Barrio Hinangayon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1100_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Hinangayon, barrio of Argao, municipality of Mogpog, Province of Marinduque, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of Hinangayon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1954.
